states.name: q
states.meaning: 8-bit D flip-flop output register; synchronous active-high reset loads 0x34 (52), otherwise loads d on the negative clock edge.

rules.condition: reset == 1 at the sampled negative edge of clk
rules.spec_quote: active high synchronous reset. The flip-flops must be reset to 0x34 rather than zero.

rules.condition: reset == 0 at the sampled negative edge of clk
rules.spec_quote: All DFFs should be triggered by the negative edge of clk.

reset.name: reset
reset.first_released_cycle: first sampled negedge on which reset is low

mid: Optional mid input changes occur after sampling, before the other edge, and are carried to the start of the next row; examples do not use mid changes.
